{"version":"Notebook/1.0","items":[{"type":1,"content":{"json":"# 🤖 Microsoft Foundry BYOV Operations Workbook

**Resource Group:** `<resource-group>` | **Region:** Australia East

This workbook provides comprehensive operational visibility into your Azure Microsoft Foundry deployment with BYOV (Bring Your Own VNet) networking.

---

## Architecture Overview
- **Hub VNet:** Central hub with Azure Firewall
- **Spoke 1 (VM VNet):** Jump box for secure access
- **Spoke 2 (AI App VNet):** Microsoft Foundry with network injection
